summary: Colour a ∈ A by the classes of f(a)_i in K'/(K ∩ K').

steps.claim: K'/(K ∩ K') is finite (its index is nonzero).
Apply tsum_le_of_encard_range_le with the colouring a ↦ (class of f(a)_i)_i ∈ (K'/(K ∩ K'))^ι; the number of colours is at most the cardinality of this finite set.
That cardinality is relIndex(K, K')^{|ι|}, and equal colours mean f(a)_i − f(b)_i ∈ K for every i.
steps.lean: repeat simp [relIndex, index, funext_iff, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem, mem_addSubgroupOf]
